description: The glass vial is small and holds a single drop of the first-frost tonic. It stays clear and liquid, even when the weather turns cold, though it seems to catch the light differently than water. The stopper is wax-sealed so the liquid stays exactly as it was when it was bottled. It is heavier than it looks.
role_link_note: A spare drop kept back from the Herbalist's festival tonic, steeped from berry and spring water like the batch itself.
